verdict.rationale: Box AI API lets users ask questions, extract metadata, and summarize/query files in natural language (box-docs-9, box-docs-26), and the hosted Box MCP server lets AI agents/apps search and act on Box files via natural-language-driven agent tooling (box-docs-11, box-docs-23, box-docs-27, box-probe-3). This covers content Q&A and agent-mediated actions but not a native natural-language command interface for the full range of Box operations (uploads, sharing, permissions, workflow) and lacks independent hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: evidence of broad natural-language control over all core Box actions (not just search/summarize), and independent/community validation of NL command reliability.
